description: List the tables and views in a schema of a registered foreign Postgres connection. Requires connection_name and schema. Returns each object's name and kind (BASE TABLE, VIEW, etc.).
embedding_description: Introspect one schema of an external/foreign Postgres database registered as a connection, returning the tables and views it contains with each object's name and kind (BASE TABLE, VIEW, MATERIALIZED VIEW, FOREIGN). The schema is passed as a bound parameter, never interpolated. This is the mid level of the read-only introspection surface for the foreign-Postgres 'super Datagrip' — call list_schemas first to pick a schema, then describe_table to see a table's columns. Requires a connection_name and a schema.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with a tables list of {name, kind} entries.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: List the tables and views with their kind (schema metadata, data_sensitivity 0.1). Suggest describe_table with a table to inspect its columns.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List the tables and views in a schema of a registered foreign Postgres connection.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: external_pg.invalid_params: missing connection_name or schema. external_pg.connection_unknown: no connection registered under that name. external_pg.auth_failed / external_pg.permission_denied: the registered credential was rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: external_pg.connection_unknown: run list_connections. external_pg.invalid_params: pass both connection_name and schema (use list_schemas to find a schema).
